pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft to moderately sharp edge gradients; shapes transition from elongated quadrilaterals on the neck to more compact, rounded geometries on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes are primary tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Corridor pixel thickness is consistent across the neck and upper flank, widening towards the ventral area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder with low-amplitude, high-frequency bristle protrusions against the background.
